//paths: expo-file-system has no `exports` map for its /legacy entry, so TypeScript resolves it to the package's own SOURCE (legacy.ts -> src/legacy/*.ts) and then typechecks it under OUR settings. It does not survive exactOptionalPropertyTypes, and a third-party file has no business failing our build. This points tsc at the declarations the package already ships — the same public surface an `exports` map would expose. Metro resolves legacy.ts at runtime and is unaffected.
